title: Astra vs Divi
description: A documentation-led comparison of Astra’s flexible theme ecosystem and Divi’s all-in-one visual-building workflow.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Astra versus Divi WordPress comparison from KreativWP.
comparisonAreas: Starter templates and preferred editor workflow
How much of the site system lives in the theme versus a visual builder
Pricing, migration, and long-term editor fit
Performance testing still required on the same representative site
takeaway: Choose Astra when you want flexibility across WordPress editing workflows; evaluate Divi when a unified visual builder and its broader ecosystem fit the team. Neither choice should be made without confirming editor ownership and migration expectations.

decisionGuide.chooseLeft: you want to choose your preferred block-editor or page-builder stack independently and value a broad starter-template ecosystem.
decisionGuide.chooseRight: your team wants to standardize on one visual builder for pages and site-wide templates.
decisionGuide.verify: Build one representative page, template, and responsive variation in each workflow. Confirm the migration path and exact plan before committing.
